parsed.post: Discarding the 1.0186 run; it regressed from my best 0.9967. The increase in LR to 0.08 was too aggressive for the 5min budget. Reverting to the best stable configuration (LR 0.05 or 0.06) and testing a small step up to 0.07 with the warmup to find the optimal peak.
parsed.description: Testing a middle-ground learning rate of 0.07 (between 0.05 and 0.08) to see if it provides more gain than 0.05 without the regression seen at 0.08.
